title: ParsHate: A Benchmark Dataset for Hate and Target Detection in Persian

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (precision, recall, and F1) in multi-label classification for identifying gender as the target of hate speech, both before and after named-entity masking.

Evaluating model performance (precision, recall, and F1) in multi-label classification for identifying political entities or ideologies as the target of hate speech, both before and after named-entity masking.
Evaluating model performance (precision, recall, and F1) in multi-label classification for identifying religion (e.g., Islam) as the target of hate speech, both before and after named-entity masking.

Evaluating model performance (precision, recall, and F1) in multi-label classification for identifying nationalities (e.g., Iranian, Afghan, Arab, Western) as the target of hate speech, both before and after named-entity masking.

Evaluating model performance (precision, recall, and F1) in multi-label classification for identifying specific occupations or professions as the target of hate speech, both before and after named-entity masking.
Evaluating model performance (precision, recall, and F1) in multi-label classification for identifying race or ethnicity as the target of hate speech, both before and after named-entity masking.
